spec.description: pebblesim: insertion throughput and per-batch timing against the simulated block deadline, plus Pebble's own disk-growth and per-level SSTable metrics — the signals for whether Pebble is keeping up as the store grows.

spec.title: SSTable File Count by Level
spec.description: pebble_sstable_count{level}. Watch L0 specifically — this repo triggers compaction at just 2 L0 files (L0CompactionThreshold), so a climbing L0 count is the earliest warning sign of write stalls.

spec.title: Compaction Throughput (bytes/sec)
spec.description: rate(pebble_compaction_bytes_written_total/_read_total), summed across levels and (if SeparateEVMSubDBs) DBs. Rising alongside data-dir size while insertion throughput stays flat is compaction falling behind.

spec.title: Pebble insertion throughput
spec.description: rate(pebble_flush_bytes_written_total) — how fast the memtable is draining to disk. Should roughly track insertion throughput; falling behind it while the memtable/WAL panel trends up is the earliest sign of trouble.

spec.title: Insertion time heatmap
spec.description: Distribution of pebblesim_write_duration_seconds (just ApplyChangesetSync/SetLatestVersion) across LatencyBuckets. A p50/p99 line can hide a shape change; here you can see the whole distribution's mass shift toward higher buckets over time, which is what insertion time actually degrading looks like as the store grows.

spec.title: Number of processes blocked waiting for I/O to complete
Number of processes in runnable state
Percentage of time when at least one task was ready to run but had to wait for CPU.
Average I/O Wait Across All CPUs (%)
Data Directory Size
spec.description: pebblesim_data_dir_size_bytes / _available_bytes — actual filesystem usage of the whole PebbleDB directory (SSTables + WAL + manifest). The single number for "is disk growing".
